integrity: Mathematical proof and standalone exact finite-state checker supplied; numerical evaluations are supporting checks and not a substitute for the all-size proof. No independent verification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only alternating positive nearest-neighbor bond rates on a finite even cycle and the event of zero terminal vacancies; no full vacancy-count or time distribution. The equal-rate baseline may already follow from Page (1959). The complete text of Page (1959), Pippenger (1989) and de Oliveira--Tome (1994) could not be inspected; bibliographic overlap risk remains.
title: Exact complete-coverage probability and symmetry crossover for alternating-rate dimer deposition on cycles
